tokens.accent: h-px w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500/60 via-slate-700 to-transparent
tokens.summary: flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-3 text-slate-200 md:hidden
tokens.summaryBadge: inline-flex min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-200
tokens.bodyWrap: hidden px-4 pb-4 pt-4 md:block md:px-5 md:py-5
tokens.group: space-y-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-950/40 p-3
tokens.option: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/40 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-500/70 hover:text-white
tokens.optionActive: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-600/20 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-100
tokens.box: flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[4px] border border-current
tokens.radio: flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-current
tokens.moreSummary: cursor-pointer text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 hover:text-indigo-300
tokens.chip: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-200 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500/20
tokens.clearAll: text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-indigo-300
tokens.field: w-full rounded-md border border-slate-700 bg-slate-950 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500/40
tokens.switchRow: inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-300
tokens.submitWrap: sticky bottom-0 z-10 -mx-4 mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/90 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur md:static md:mx-0 md:border-0 md:bg-transparent md:p-0
tokens.submit: inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500
